evidence.quote: Owned intelligence is not the same as rented intelligence.

observations.why: The owned/rented opposition frames intelligence as a property-and-cost distinction, enacting market-pricing proportionality.

evidence.quote: the perspective is the asset you keep

observations.why: Calling perspective an 'asset you keep' against a 'commodity' substrate performs market-pricing: value retention and proportionality between what is fungible and what is held.
